content.title: Pinterest (PINS): Profit Margin Jumps to 49.3%, Challenging Doubters of Sustainable Growth
content.summary: Pinterest (PINS) reported net profit margins of 49.3%, a sharp jump from last year’s 5.8%, with annual earnings growth averaging 64.3% over the past five years. Most notably, the company’s recent earnings shot up by 903%, easily beating its long-term average. Growth expectations remain robust, as earnings are forecast to rise 28% per year and revenue by 11.8% per year. Both figures are projected to outpace the average for the broader US market. content.title: One Consequence of Tariffs: Advertisers are Pulling Back, Pinterest Says
content.summary: In one sign of the impact tariffs have had on the economy, social media company Pinterest said large advertisers were pulling back on spending because they are strapped by tariffs.  Ad pricing at the company declined 24% in the third quarter, as U.S. retailers navigated "tariff-related margin pressure," Chief Financial Officer Julia Donnelly said.  Pinterest shares were down more than 20% Wednesday.
